description_html:
Tulsee Doshi is head of product for Google’s frontier AI models, including Gemini and other multimodal models, such as Nano Banana, Genie, Veo, and Lyria.

We discuss:

1. Why model development is not just engineering, but also like Snape’s potions class

2. Google’s full-stack frontier AI strategy

3. What PMs do inside a frontier AI lab

4. Tulsee’s 60-20-20 framework for balancing what works now and what’s almost working

5. How to write your first eval

6. The rising value of great PMs

—

Brought to you by:

WorkOS—Make your app enterprise-ready, with SSO, SCIM, RBAC, and more

DX—Engineering intelligence for the AI era

—

Episode transcript: https://www.lennysnewsletter.com/p/what-it-actually-takes-to-build-frontier

—

—

Highlights: https://lennyspodcast.com/mostreplayedmoments

—

• LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/tulsee-doshi

—

Where to find Lenny:

• Newsletter: https://www.lennysnewsletter.com

• X: https://twitter.com/lennysan

• LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/lennyrachitsky/

—

In this episode, we cover:

(00:00) Teaser

(01:08) What people misunderstand about how models are built

(06:28) Google’s strategy in the AI race

(09:57) AI safety, monitoring, and strengthening cyberdefenses

(14:10) Balancing fast launches with great user experiences

(17:02) Why the model itself has a UX

(19:21) Why product managers are becoming more valuable

(21:24) The skills that matter for research PMs

(23:04) How to build your first eval

(24:37) Getting better at judging a model’s vibes

(26:15) Improving skin tone representation with better evals

(28:25) Evaluating the full experience, not just the model

(30:38) From crowdsourced flash teams to agent swarms

(33:13) The 60-20-20 rule for building ahead of model capabilities

(35:46) Keeping your product adaptable as models improve

(36:42) What an AI harness actually is

(37:30) Upskilling PMs through shared skills and workshops

(41:18) Building the habit of asking, “Can AI do this for me?”

(42:38) Google’s opportunity to build a personal AI assistant

(44:10) Burnout, meaningful work, and the pressure to do more

(47:44) Avoiding AI slop

(49:30) How AI is changing the PM role

(51:02) Lightning round and final thoughts

—

References: https://www.lennysnewsletter.com/p/what-it-actually-takes-to-build-frontier
